subject: English
passage: Recently, marine biologists examined sonar data collected by deep-sea research vessels to learn more about whale migration patterns in the Pacific Ocean. The data reveal that all the humpback whales followed identical migration routes during their journey south. This discovery was surprising to researchers, as they expected that the whales would take varied paths across the ocean because of the abundance of food sources scattered throughout the region. Now, researchers believe that there could be previously unknown underwater currents that guide the whales along specific corridors.
prompt: According to the text, what was surprising to researchers studying the whale migration data from deep-sea research vessels?

choices.A: The food sources in the Pacific Ocean have been decreasing.
choices.B: There were different types of sonar signals affecting whale behavior.
choices.C: All the humpback whales followed identical migration routes during their journey south.
choices.D: Deep-sea research vessels collected less data than researchers had expected.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer because it presents a statement about what surprised the researchers that is supported by the text. The text states that the humpback whales described in the sonar data from deep-sea research vessels followed identical migration routes. The text goes on to say that because they had expected the opposite (that whales would take varied paths across the ocean) this discovery surprised the researchers.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because the text doesn't say that the data from deep-sea research vessels revealed any surprising information about food source levels. Instead, the text mentions the abundance of food sources as a reason the researchers expected that whales would take multiple paths. In addition, abundance would indicate that food sources are plentiful rather than decreasing.
